GLOBAL SPEC v2 — STYLE: 3D DIORAMA TAROT STOP-MOTION & DYNAMIC PHOTO EVOLUTION
Cinematic 3D tactile miniature diorama set based on the Rider-Waite-Smith (RWS) Tarot. Handcrafted 3D resin, clay, polished wood, and heavy paper stop-motion figures placed on a mini theatrical stage. Professional studio lighting with dramatic rim lighting, volumetric shadows, rich saturated color palette, and subtle tilt-shift depth of field.

IMAGE TRANSFORMATION SEQUENCE:
Archival Rider-Waite-Smith tarot card illustrations and historical photos transition seamlessly: starting as a flat high-contrast black-and-white print, shifting into warm vintage Kodachrome lithographic color tones, and finally extruding into a fully volumetric 3D photorealistic scene inside the diorama.

TYPOGRAPHY & COMPOSITION:
Bold 3D kinetic typography using mystical editorial serif letterforms with gold-foil or matte finish, positioned in the lower third, casting soft realistic shadows onto the stage floor. Text snaps into frame with stop-motion timing. High detail, 8k resolution.
